how_to_grade: An answer is correct if, for every group in must_include, it contains at least one of the group's strings (ignoring case). An answer has the right citation if it cites at least one page listed in pages. For questions with answerable=false, the pages list is empty and there is nothing to cite.

questions.question: When are the instructor's office hours?
How many GPU-hours does each final project team receive on the Osprey cluster?
What letter grade does an overall score of 72 receive?
In which room is the midterm exam held?
Where and when are the weekly lab sections held?
When is Assignment 3 due?
How long before the deadline must an extension be requested?
questions.expected_answer: At least 48 hours before the deadline.

questions.question: Which teaching assistant handles questions about grading?
Can grace days be used for the final project report?
questions.expected_answer: No. Grace days can be used on the four assignments only.

questions.question: A student has an overall score of 60 but scored 35% on the final project. Do they pass the course?
questions.expected_answer: No. Students must score at least 40% on the final project to pass, regardless of their overall score.

questions.question: How many in-class quizzes can a student miss without affecting their grade?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 2, because only the best 8 of the 10 quizzes count.

questions.question: A student with all 3 grace days available submits an assignment 5 days late and uses all of their grace days. What percentage of the assignment's marks is deducted?
questions.expected_answer: 30%. Three days are covered by grace days, and the other 2 days cost 15% each.

questions.question: A student with all 3 grace days available submits an assignment 7 days late and uses all of their grace days. What mark do they receive?
questions.expected_answer: A mark of zero, because the submission is still more than 3 days late after grace days are used.

questions.question: Together, what percentage of the final grade do the midterm exam and the project poster make up?
Which of these can a student use during the midterm exam: handwritten notes, a calculator, a phone, an AI assistant?
questions.expected_answer: One A4 sheet of handwritten notes (both sides) and a calculator are allowed. Phones and AI tools are not allowed.

questions.question: During which week of the course schedule is Assignment 1 due?
questions.expected_answer: Week 4. Assignment 1 is due on Friday, February 5, and Week 4 starts on February 1.
